The word "decomposing" is mentioned in 0.0% of neuroscience papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "decomposing" , 36.1% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a higher rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "decomposing" are in the top 72nd percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better).
Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
